items.title: Eblen Rau Interview, 1974-05-27
items.q: We'd go out to Pierron's and play the music at it, Spanish Fort, Pierron's band. Oh yeah. That was our picnic. We'd come to listen to music on a Monday night.

ctx.x: Well, was that at the time the olives were still largely a string group or was that after the transition to the winds?

Well, it was between times. I mean we started off as a string group in there. I think they used to call it the Invincibles, I believe was one of their names. But we had a little outfit that started over on the Gulf Coast. I remember I had to quit school. I mean I'd started to work and they made this arrangement over there at the Miramar Hotel. They played part of the time at the Miramar Hotel, which is where the big hotel is, the one that just blew up a few years ago. We'd go on a streetcar that used to run right…
Did you ever go to Trancinas?
